name: When should I consider accessibility modifications during a kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider accessibility modifications during a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider accessibility updates if you plan to age in place or accommodate family members with limited mobility. Key modifications include lowering countertop sections, installing pull-out cabinet shelves, widening doorways for walker or wheelchair clearance, and choosing lever-style faucets and hardware. HH Remodeling provides dedicated disability and accessibility modifications across residential spaces. Our crew can reconfigure lower cabinetry, adjust reach distances, and modify drywall openings to improve overall access and safety throughout your kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider accessibility features if you plan to age in place or need easier reach, incorporating pull-out shelving, varied counter heights, and wider interior walkways.
